clauses.title: Context of the organization
clauses.description: Understanding the organization and its context, interested parties, and scope of the ISMS.

clauses.title: Leadership
clauses.description: Leadership and commitment, policy, and organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities.

clauses.title: Planning
clauses.description: Actions to address risks and opportunities, and information security objectives.

clauses.title: Support
clauses.description: Resources, competence, awareness, communication, and documented information.

clauses.title: Operation
clauses.description: Operational planning and control, information security risk assessment and treatment.

clauses.title: Performance evaluation
clauses.description: Monitoring, measurement, analysis, evaluation, internal audit, and management review.

clauses.title: Improvement
clauses.description: Nonconformity and corrective action, and continual improvement.

controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals and if significant changes occur.

controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to the organization needs.

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.description: Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility shall be segregated.

controls.title: Management responsibilities
controls.description: Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures of the organization.

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities.

controls.title: Contact with special interest groups
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations.

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.description: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.

controls.title: Information security in project management
controls.description: Information security shall be integrated into project management.

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.description: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained.

controls.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use and procedures for handling information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented and implemented.

controls.title: Return of assets
controls.description: Personnel and other interested parties shall return all the organization's assets in their possession upon change or termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.description: Information shall be classified according to the organization's needs based on confidentiality, integrity, availability and relevant interested party requirements.

controls.title: Labelling of information
controls.description: Procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the organization's classification scheme.

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.description: Information transfer rules, procedures or agreements shall be in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organization and between the organization and other parties.

controls.title: Access control
controls.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and security requirements.

controls.title: Identity management
controls.description: The full life cycle of identities shall be managed.

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.description: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process.

controls.title: Access rights
controls.description: Access rights shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed in accordance with the organization's access control policy.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.description: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage risks associated with supplier products or services.

controls.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.description: Relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier.

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.description: Processes and procedures shall manage risks associated with ICT products and services supply chain.

controls.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.description: Supplier information security practices and service delivery shall be regularly monitored, reviewed and evaluated.

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.description: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services shall be established.

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.description: Information security incident management processes, roles and responsibilities shall be defined and communicated.

controls.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.description: Information security events shall be assessed to determine if they qualify as incidents.

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.description: Incidents shall be responded to in accordance with documented procedures.

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.description: Knowledge gained from incidents shall be used to improve controls.

controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.description: Procedures for identification, collection and preservation of evidence shall be implemented.

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.description: Information security shall be maintained at an appropriate level during disruption.

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.description: ICT readiness shall be planned, implemented, maintained and tested.

controls.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.description: Relevant requirements shall be identified, documented and kept up to date.

controls.title: Intellectual property rights
controls.description: Procedures shall protect intellectual property rights.

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.description: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification and unauthorized access.

controls.title: Privacy and protection of PII
controls.description: Privacy and protection of PII shall meet applicable legal and contractual requirements.

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.description: Information security management shall be independently reviewed at planned intervals.

controls.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
controls.description: Compliance with security policies and standards shall be regularly reviewed.

controls.title: Documented operating procedures
controls.description: Operating procedures shall be documented and available to personnel.

controls.title: Screening
controls.description: Background verification checks shall be carried out prior to joining and periodically as appropriate.

controls.title: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.description: Employment agreements shall state security responsibilities.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: Personnel shall receive appropriate security awareness and training.

controls.title: Disciplinary process
controls.description: A formal disciplinary process shall address policy violations.

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.description: Post-employment security responsibilities shall be defined and enforced.

controls.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.description: Confidentiality agreements shall be documented, reviewed and signed.

controls.title: Remote working
controls.description: Security measures shall protect information during remote working.

controls.title: Information security event reporting
controls.description: Mechanisms shall allow timely reporting of security events.

controls.title: Physical security perimeters
controls.description: Security perimeters shall protect sensitive areas.

controls.title: Physical entry
controls.description: Secure areas shall have appropriate entry controls.

controls.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.description: Physical security shall be designed and implemented.

controls.title: Physical security monitoring
controls.description: Premises shall be monitored for unauthorized access.

controls.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.description: Protection shall address natural and physical threats.

controls.title: Working in secure areas
controls.description: Security measures shall apply in secure areas.

controls.title: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.description: Clear desk and clear screen rules shall be enforced.

controls.title: Equipment siting and protection
controls.description: Equipment shall be securely located and protected.

controls.title: Security of assets off-premises
controls.description: Off-site assets shall be protected.

controls.title: Storage media
controls.description: Storage media shall be managed through its life cycle.

controls.title: Supporting utilities
controls.description: Facilities shall be protected from power and utility failures.

controls.title: Cabling security
controls.description: Power and data cables shall be protected.

controls.title: Equipment maintenance
controls.description: Equipment shall be properly maintained.

controls.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.description: Sensitive data shall be securely removed before disposal or reuse.

controls.title: User endpoint devices
controls.description: Information on endpoint devices shall be protected.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.description: Privileged access shall be restricted and managed.

controls.title: Information access restriction
controls.description: Access shall follow established access control policies.

controls.title: Access to source code
controls.description: Access to source code and development tools shall be managed.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented.

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.description: Resource usage shall be monitored and adjusted.

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.description: Malware protection shall be implemented.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Vulnerabilities shall be identified, evaluated and addressed.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.description: Configurations shall be established, documented and monitored.

controls.title: Information deletion
controls.description: Information shall be deleted when no longer required.

controls.title: Data masking
controls.description: Data masking shall be used where appropriate.

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.description: Backups shall be maintained and tested.

controls.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.description: Redundancy shall meet availability requirements.

controls.title: Logging
controls.description: Logs shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.description: Systems shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour.

controls.title: Clock synchronization
controls.description: System clocks shall be synchronized.

controls.title: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.description: Use of privileged utilities shall be restricted.

controls.title: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.description: Software installation shall be securely managed.

controls.title: Network security
controls.description: Networks and devices shall be secured and controlled.

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.description: Network service security requirements shall be identified and monitored.

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.description: Information services and systems shall be segregated.

controls.title: Web filtering
controls.description: Access to external websites shall be managed.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.description: Cryptography and key management rules shall be defined and implemented.

controls.title: Secure development life cycle
controls.description: Secure development rules shall be applied.

controls.title: Application security requirements
controls.description: Security requirements shall be identified when developing or acquiring applications.

controls.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.description: Secure engineering principles shall be established and applied.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.description: Secure coding principles shall be applied.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.description: Security testing shall be implemented in the development life cycle.

controls.title: Outsourced development
controls.description: Outsourced development activities shall be directed and reviewed.

controls.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.description: Environments shall be separated and secured.

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: Changes shall follow formal change management procedures.

controls.title: Test information
controls.description: Test information shall be protected and managed.

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.description: Audit testing of operational systems shall be planned and agreed with management.
